The provided information lists order IDs and refund amounts, but it does not provide a list of customers or their associated order/refund data to calculate the net balance for payout. I need to list the orders to determine the customers involved before I can check their net balance and record payouts.

Now that I have the orders, I need to determine the net balance for each customer: acme, birch, and cobalt. The refunds reported are for order_ids 240, 243, and 245. I must call `net_balance(customer)` for each unique customer: acme, birch, and cobalt. I will start with acme.
I have the net balance for 'acme' (12837 cents). Next, I will get the net balance for 'birch'.
I have the net balance for 'birch' (55306 cents). Next, I will get the net balance for 'cobalt'.

I have the net balances for all three customers: acme (12837 cents), birch (55306 cents), and cobalt (28827 cents). Now I need to record a payout for each customer using `record_payout(customer, amount_cents)`.
Payout recorded for 'acme'. Next, I will record the payout for 'birch'.
Payout recorded for 'birch'. Next, I will record the payout for 'cobalt'.
All payouts have been successfully recorded for acme, birch, and cobalt. I will now finish the task report.
